_comment: Optional watch file for goal-continuation turns, saved as ~/.codex/ateles/turn_guard/goal_watch.json. The Ateles codex_turn_guard hashes each command's output together with the last operator message and the repository state; a goal turn is treated as having nothing new only while all of them are unchanged. Without this file, a state kept outside the repository (CI, a pull request, a daemon, a Neotoma record) is seen only when the back-off window lapses (5 min doubling to base_s*2^n, at most cap_s). argv is run without a shell, read-only, 6 s each and 12 s in total.
